ranking_scope: Among scored candidates and chosen profiles only; unscored evidence gaps can conceal other effective materials.
score_meaning: Project chosen evidence applicability and practical setup preference score. Not a removal percentage, efficiency prediction or probability.
sensitivity_scope: Two alternate weight choices with chosen material profiles held fixed; not proof of global ranking robustness.
profile_selection_policy: Within each family: status, then largest lower score bound, then profile ID for stable display. Overlapping profile alternatives are flagged.
assumptions: Batch mixing is a prototype setup requirement; where the abstract does not describe agitation, this is an engineering assumption rather than an extracted experiment parameter.
Unknown criterion ratings span zero to two; no midpoint or weight renormalisation is used.
One family row describes a named chosen profile, not universal performance of every material in that family.
Conditional candidates are ranked only when allow_conditional_ranking is explicitly true.
The policy never gives extra score merely because a candidate has an ML prediction.
Known mismatched conditions imply conditional transferability, not proof of poor removal.
Conditional research candidates included in ranking: True.
Matching a literature observation is not an independent validation or proof of the requested performance.
No source quantity or ML prediction is numerically added to the decision score.

scenario.demo_note: First eligible sulfamethoxazole holdout row, otherwise first eligible holdout row; chosen by inputs, not smallest prediction error.
